strategies.name: opening_15m_range_fvg_limit_order_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then place a limit order at the fair value gap so that a retrace into the gap automatically enters the trade in the breakout दिशा.

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct strategies are taught: the scalping version requires a retest-plus-engulfing entry and uses a 3:1 target, while the day-trading version uses a passive limit entry at the FVG and a 2:1 target.
